questions.text: How is a saved entry edited?
options: By re-typing the short form, pre-filled with the saved typed text (e.g. UBR 180 12/11 airport)
Field by field (merchant, category, amount, date, note)
questions.reason: REQ-280 open question and walkthrough gap 11. The expenses table keeps typed_text for exactly this pre-fill (db_design). The short form reuses the REQ-276 rules; field by field needs new validation for each field.
questions.answer: By re-typing the short form, pre-filled with the saved typed text (e.g. UBR 180 12/11 airport)

questions.text: Do the abbreviation rules and their exact error messages apply to an edit, so an invalid edit is refused with the rule's message and the entry stays unchanged?
questions.reason: REQ-280 open question; the acceptance criterion says 'to confirm'.

questions.text: In an edit, what do td, yd and dd/mm mean?
options: Relative to the day of the edit (today in IST), like a new entry
Relative to the entry's saved date
questions.reason: REQ-280 open question. Re-saving 'SWG 340 yd' a week later would move the entry by a week with the first option; to keep the date, the user would type it as dd/mm.
questions.answer: Relative to the entry's saved date

questions.text: Which saved entries does the saved-entries list show, and in which order?
options: One month at a time with Previous / Next like the summary (current month first), newest date first
One month at a time, oldest date first
questions.reason: REQ-280 open question 'Where does the user find the entry to edit?' and WI-048 q3 (the list comes with REQ-280/REQ-281). A month view matches the summary; 'all' grows without limit.
questions.answer: One month at a time with Previous / Next like the summary (current month first), newest date first

questions.text: Where is the saved-entries list and how is it reached?
options: A page at /saved-entries, with links from the entry box and the summary
On the summary page, under the totals of the same month
Something else (please describe in a comment)
questions.reason: The app has /entries and /summary. The walkthrough showed a separate list (S03) reached from the summary and a tab. Columns would be: typed, merchant, category, amount, date, note, plus Edit (and Delete with REQ-281).
questions.answer: A page at /saved-entries, with links from the entry box and the summary

questions.text: How does the edit itself work, and where does the user land afterwards?
options: Inline in the list: Edit turns the row into a text box with Save and Cancel; after Save the row shows the new values
A separate edit page; after Save the user goes back to the list
questions.reason: Walkthrough gaps 11 and 12 (edit form and landing after an edit are not defined).
questions.answer: Inline in the list: Edit turns the row into a text box with Save and Cancel; after Save the row shows the new values

questions.text: Is an edit saved directly (no review step), with the expanded result shown before confirming only if there is an error?
questions.reason: New entries are reviewed before Save (REQ-278). For one corrected entry a separate review step may be unnecessary; if yes, the edit shows the rule error or saves at once and the row shows the new values.
